head.title: Fits and pricing
head.text: Prices are listed so you can plan, and they include everything in the session. Parts you choose to buy are extra and never required. A second bike fitted in the same visit is $150.

touchpointTitle: Touchpoint sessions, for riders fitted in the last two years

included.title: Every full fit includes
included.text: No upgrades, no surprise line items.
items: Pre-fit questionnaire so we start informed
One rider in the studio at a time
Changes made to your bike on the day
Written report with photos and video
Your fit numbers kept on file, for life
Shim and wedge stock on hand

cta.title: Ready when you are
cta.text: Pick a session and a few days that work, and we'll confirm a time within one business day.
